name: Dranik Hollows: West
summary: A broad cavern network used as a Muramite staging ground and Dragorn resistance infiltration route.
description: Hollows West is the widest and most strategically important section of the Dranik Hollows. Broad caverns and reinforced tunnels make it ideal for Muramite staging operations. Supply lines, patrol routes, and temporary encampments dot the western tunnels. Dragorn resistance fighters use hidden side passages and collapsed side tunnels to infiltrate and sabotage Muramite operations. Discord energy is present but less concentrated than in the East, manifesting as unstable pockets rather than full ruptures.
